thread:
alex: Alert from runtime-monitor: multiple nodes failed `ldd` on /usr/lib/libz.so.1 after yesterday's base rebuild. tagging: redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20
priya: Oof. Which CVE shows up in SBOM? Syft quick scan?
jon: Running `syft redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20 -o json` now. Early output: zlib v1.2.13 -> CVE-2026-2100 (compression exploitable).
laura: Was the patch supposed to include upstream zlib bump? I remember the rebase ticket pinned versions.
alex: Rebase PR merged last night updated many deps; looks like zlib moved to a newer major but our vulnerability whitelist didn't include the new advisory.
marta: Any signing failures? We need to know if automated signing ran. If not, we shouldn't let fleets pick this tag.
jon: cosign verify shows signed, but weird: signature metadata claims signer: `ci-baker@redwood`. `gcloud kms get-iam-policy` shows the key no longer lists `ci-baker` after an org-level cleanup. But signature exists from earlier upload.
priya: If the signer lost access after key rotation, future tags won't be signed. Who rotated keys?
laura: Ops rotated the KMS key last night per rotation schedule. They created a new key version and destroyed the old one. We probably didn't attach the bake principal to the new version.
ops-bot: Scheduled rotation: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/runtime-sign rotated (v4 created) at 03:12 UTC.
alex: OK. Two problems: (A) CVE in zlib in the new image; (B) signer lost access to new key version so CI might fail on rebuilds.
priya: Proposal: 1) temporarily denylist `redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20` from prod pulls, 2) hotpatch image by rebuilding only zlib layer and produce `2026-03-20-zlibfix-signed`, 3) restore bake principal to new key version with limited role, 4) enable KMS audit logs and registry SBOM checks. Thoughts?
laura: Agree. Also: capture SBOM artifacts and push to internal attestations so we can trace which customers pulled the bad tag.
marta: I'll create a registry deny rule and a registrar entry for the quarantine. Quarantine applied -> prod and dedicated fleets blocked.
jon: Starting minimal rebuild: `bazel run //images:runtime-minimal -- --update-package zlib=1.2.14 --minimize-layers`
priya: Before signing I need IAM to use new key version: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding runtime-sign --member=serviceAccount:ci-baker@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner`? Or should it be encrypter/decrypter?
laura: For cosign with KMS we need `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersionSigner` on the specific key version. Keep scope narrow to the key version resource.
marta: I can add the binding but will add `--condition` that limits signing to the CI project timeframe. Also setting an approval flow in infra change log.
ops-bot: infra-change created: CL-4572 (attach signer role to new key version) by marta.
priya: Rebuild completed. Generated SBOM and attestation. Trying `cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/runtime-sign/cryptoKeyVersions/4 redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20-zlibfix` -> permission denied: "cryptoKeyVersions.signerRoleMissing"
laura: I pushed the binding; please retry. I limited the role to `resource.name.endsWith('/cryptoKeyVersions/4')` and added `requester=infra` tag.
priya: Retry -> cosign success. `cosign verify` -> Verified: ok.
jon: Canary rollout to staging 3 nodes. Watching for OOM/crash loops (zlib can affect decompression paths).
alex: Also run dynamic fuzzing on image decompress path for 10 minutes while canary is up. Use `ffuzz` harness in staging.
marta: I've enabled KMS audit sink to BigQuery for 14 days and added a quick alert if `SetIamPolicy` occurs on the signing key outside infra team.
laura: Good. After canary stays healthy for 20m we'll promote and update fleet policies. Create a small advisory to internal customers: include CVE ID, affected tag, mitigation, and ask security contacts to rotate if they consumed the vulnerable tag.
priya: Patch pushed as signed tag `redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20-zlibfix-signed`. SBOM/artifacts uploaded to attestations.
jon: Staging canary green 25m. Promoting to canary-prod (5 nodes) then full rollout.
ops-bot: Registry quarantine lifted for `redwood/runtime-minimal:2026-03-20` after replacement push. Old tag moved to `quarantine/2026-03-20-archived`.
sec-bot: Incident note: root cause = key rotation + missing IAM binding + overlooked SBOM advisory. Recommended: automation to verify signer principal post-rotation and fail rotations if verification fails.
alex: Filing postmortem ticket PM-789. Action items: (1) infra: add signer-check to rotation runbook (2) eng-runtime: add SBOM gate to PR merges that bump base deps (3) product: notify ingesting teams.
laura: Also consider adding a guardrail that prevents key destruction until all active signatures validated.
marta: Will follow up in CL-4572 and schedule a 30-min retro. Closing incident in thread. Thanks all.
